method: normalized source signatures, supplementary and not Lean4 Comparator

signatures.diagonal_stationary_iff: (s : Fin 3 → ℝ) (hs : Admissible s) (X : Mat 3) (c : ℝ) : Stationary (Matrix.diagonal s) X c ↔ ∃ x : Fin 3 → ℝ, X = Matrix.diagonal x ∧ (∀ i, (x i) ^ 2 - s i * x i + c = 0) ∧ |∏ i, x i| = 1
signatures.diagonal_counterexample: (s : Fin 3 → ℝ) (hs : Admissible s) : ∃ t : ℝ, 0 < t ∧ t < 13 / 25 ∧ UniqueLeastStationary (Matrix.diagonal s) (selectedMatrix s t) (-t) ∧ Feasible (improvedMatrix s t) ∧ frobeniusNorm (Matrix.diagonal s - improvedMatrix s t) < frobeniusNorm (Matrix.diagonal s - selectedMatrix s t)
signatures.orthogonal_transport: {n : ℕ} (P Q U X : Mat n) (c : ℝ) (hP : Orthogonal P) (hQ : Orthogonal Q) : (Feasible (P * X * Qᵀ) ↔ Feasible X) ∧ frobeniusNorm (P * (U - X) * Qᵀ) = frobeniusNorm (U - X) ∧ (Stationary (P * U * Qᵀ) (P * X * Qᵀ) c ↔ Stationary U X c)
signatures.spectral_family: : IsOpen counterexampleFamily ∧ sampleMatrix ∈ counterexampleFamily ∧ ∀ U ∈ counterexampleFamily, ∃ s : Fin 3 → ℝ, Admissible s ∧ HasSVD U s
signatures.regular_svd: (U : Mat 3) (s : Fin 3 → ℝ) (hs : Admissible s) (hsvd : HasSVD U s) : RegularData U
signatures.algebraic_avoidance: (S : Set (Mat 3)) (hS : IsOpen S) (hne : S.Nonempty) (p : MvPolynomial (Fin 3 × Fin 3) ℝ) (hp : p ≠ 0) : ∃ U ∈ S, MvPolynomial.eval (fun ij => U ij.1 ij.2) p ≠ 0
signatures.generic_counterexamples: (p : MvPolynomial (Fin 3 × Fin 3) ℝ) (hp : p ≠ 0) : ∃ U : Mat 3, MvPolynomial.eval (fun ij => U ij.1 ij.2) p ≠ 0 ∧ SelectionFails U
